name: Statutes of limitations by state: personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability and property damage
description: The filing deadline the statute sets for five kinds of civil claims in every US state and DC: personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability and property damage. Each record gives the period in the statute's own words, the citation, a link to the state's official code site, a verbatim quote, and the date read; where the same text says so, it adds whether the period runs from discovery and any outer limit (statute of repose). Some cells come from a court opinion that quotes or applies the statute; they are marked S (secondary) and name the court, case and date. No calculator and no deadline arithmetic: tolling and exceptions apply.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Statutes of limitations by state: personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability and property damage (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963806

distribution.name: limitations.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: limitations.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: limitations-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in limitations-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to limitations.csv on id.

recordSet.name: limitations
recordSet.description: The records of Statutes of limitations by state: personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability and property damage, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code, DC, US (federal), ABA, or PLATFORM:<name>

field.name: claimType
field.description: pi (personal injury), medmal (medical malpractice), wd (wrongful death), product (product liability) or property (property damage)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: years
field.description: The period in years as the statute states it (fractions for periods stated in months)

field.name: period
field.description: The period in the statute's own terms, e.g. 2 years or 2 years and 6 months

field.name: statuteCite
field.description: The statute section the period comes from

field.name: basis
field.description: specific when the statute names the claim type; general when the period is the state's general or residual period and the statute's words do not name the claim type

field.name: quote
field.description: A verbatim quote from the official statute text

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
